visual_elements.description: Binary confusion-matrix tree. Top: 'Positive' (red label) with airplane icon and 'Negative' (green label) with airplane icon. Negative branches down to green circle '70', which splits to green circle '59' (left) and red circle '11' (right). Bottom labels: TP under 20, FN under 10, TN under 59, FP under 11. Arrows connect each parent node to its children.

Binary confusion-matrix tree. Top: 'Positive' (red label) with airplane icon and 'Negative' (green label) with airplane icon. recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to white. 2. Add title text 'Combine Precision and Recall in one number' at top-left in bold dark red (~#CC0000), large sans-serif. 3. Add a yellow filled circle at top-right with the number '16' in black. 4. Draw the left confusion-matrix diagram: place 'Positive' (red bold) with a small airplane icon and 'Negative' (green bold) with a small airplane icon at the top; below Positive draw a red circle '30' and below Negative a green circle '70'; from the '30' circle draw two arrows down to a red circle '20' (left) and a green circle '10' (right); from the '70' circle draw two arrows down to a green circle '59' (left) and a red circle '11' (right); label beneath the bottom row: TP, FN, TN, FP. 5. Draw the right confusion-matrix diagram identically but with bottom-row values: red '30', green '0', green '0', red '70' and labels TP, FN, TN, FP. 6. On the right side add two blue-bordered boxes: top box 'Precision = TP / (TP + FP)' with TP in a small blue pill; bottom box 'Recall = TP / (TP + FN)' with TP in a small blue pill. 7. Add a green-bordered box in the lower-center containing the stacked fraction 1/F1 Score = (1/2)*(1/Precision + 1/Recall) with 'F1 Score' as a label under the left fraction. 8. Add an orange-bordered box to the right of the F1 box with two lines: 'Penalize Small Value (X) by Using 1/X' and 'Normalize (by * 0.5) to get F1 Score between 0,1'. 9. Along the bottom add two columns of three light-bordered boxes each. Left column: 'Precision= 20/(20+11) =64.5%', 'Recall= 20/(20+10) =66.6%', 'F1 Score= 68.7%+60% =65.55%'. Right column: 'Precision= 30/(30+70) =30.3%', 'Recall= 30/(30+0) =100%', 'F1 Score= 30.3%+100% =46%'. In the F1 boxes make 'F1 Score' red and the final percentage blue. 10. Use red (#FF0000) and green (#008000) for all circle fills and class labels; blue (#DEEBF7 fill, #2E75B6 border) for formula boxes; orange (#FCE4D6 fill, #C55A11 border) for the explanation box; green (#00B050) border for the F1 formula box.
